IncidentDef.label: abandoned wraith cloning installation discovered
IncidentDef.letterText: Long-range biological echoes have isolated a sealed Wraith population-production complex. Its cultivation network has collapsed, but rows of gestation cocoons and donor-transfer machinery remain inside. The ruins explain more of how mature Hives sustain themselves, but they are not functioning cloning technology. Cultured biomass and field equipment may still be recoverable; surviving Wraith caretakers sometimes return to reclaim such sites.
